app.title: HELL YEAH!! v2.0.5
app.message:
v2.0.5 has arrived.

• Comments now support episode-based filtering, so you can finally read comments for the episode you're watching instead of accidentally discovering the entire plot from someone living twelve episodes in the future.

• Cloudstream support has been added.

Please update when you get the chance. Also, Akimitsu is an idiot. This statement is unrelated to any feature, bug fix, or technical discussion and exists solely because we believe in transparent communication.

If anything breaks, remember that software development is just convincing electricity to hallucinate in a structured manner.
